en.askTitle: Put in your own dates, passports and budget and get the same Seoul plan, with entry rules checked first
en.runTitle: Hong Kong to Seoul: two friends, four days in April 2027, about USD 1,200 each

fields.label: Travellers and passport types
fields.value: Two friends in their late 20s, flying in from Hong Kong

fields.label: Flights and airport terminal
fields.value: Land in the morning of 15 April and leave in the evening of 18 April

fields.label: Budget and currency
fields.value: About USD 1,200 per person, excluding flights

fields.label: Room needs
fields.placeholder: e.g. one twin room for the two of us

fields.label: Walking comfort
fields.placeholder: e.g. up to 15,000 steps a day, no steep climbs

fields.label: Food, shopping and nightlife priorities
fields.value: Food markets and street food, one palace, one hike or nature spot, a nightlife neighbourhood and some shopping

en.template: Plan my Seoul trip for {dates}, with {travellers}, {flights}, {budget}, {rooms}, {walking} and {interests}. Make the route manageable, separate price examples from quotes for my dates, and show entry checks, rainy-day swaps and airport buffers. Plan only; do not book or pay.

phases.title: Check entry rules, airport and city transport, hotel prices and blossom timing
phases.note: K-ETA rules for Hong Kong passports, airport trains and a few Hongdae hotel prices
phases.judgment: It would not promise visa-free entry. The official K-ETA exemption for Hong Kong passports ends on 31 December 2026 and nothing official yet covers April 2027, so the plan says to re-check and, unless an extension appears, get K-ETA approval before boarding.

phases.title: Write the day-by-day plan, the cost table and the source notes
phases.note: Daily routes, a budget with contingency and dated sources
phases.judgment: Hotel prices are only examples. The L7 Hongdae price (US$335 a night) came from an undated search listing that the page itself would not confirm, so it is marked unconfirmed and the US$121-a-night option is the one to start from.

phases.title: Final check of the files, the budget sums and the page layout
phases.judgment: It said plainly what it could not finish: the layout and budget checks passed, but the screenshot step timed out, so how the page looks was not fully inspected.

workers: Found hotel options around Hongdae, with the prices shown publicly and the date each was seen
Read Korea’s official entry pages for Hong Kong passport holders: the K-ETA exemption and its end date, the fee and the arrival card

zh.askTitle: 换成你自己的日期、护照和预算，得到同样的首尔行程，并先查清入境规定
zh.runTitle: 香港到首尔：两位朋友，2027 年 4 月四天，每人约 1,200 美元

fields.label: 旅行日期
fields.value: 2027 年 4 月 15 日（周四）至 4 月 18 日（周日）

fields.label: 同行人数和护照种类
fields.value: 两位 20 代后期的朋友，从香港出发

fields.label: 航班及机场航站楼
fields.value: 4 月 15 日上午到达，4 月 18 日晚上离开

fields.label: 预算和币种
fields.value: 每人约 1,200 美元，不含机票

fields.label: 房间需求
fields.placeholder: 例如：两人住一间双床房

fields.label: 可接受的步行强度
fields.placeholder: 例如：每天最多走 15,000 步，不爬陡坡

fields.label: 餐饮、购物及夜生活偏好
fields.value: 美食市场和街头小吃、一座宫殿、一处登山或自然景点、一个夜生活区，再加一点购物

zh.template: 请按{dates}、{travellers}、{flights}、{budget}、{rooms}、{walking}和{interests}，帮我安排首尔旅行。路线别太赶，分清价格例子和我的日期实际报价，列出入境核查、雨天替换及机场缓冲。只做计划，不预订、不付款。

phases.title: 核对入境规定、机场与市内交通、酒店价格和花期
phases.note: 香港护照的 K-ETA 规定、机场铁路和弘大几家酒店的价格
phases.judgment: 它没有轻率承诺免签入境。香港护照的官方 K-ETA 豁免只到 2026 年 12 月 31 日，2027 年 4 月目前没有官方说法，所以方案提醒出发前再核对；若没有延期，就要在登机前办好 K-ETA。

phases.title: 写出逐日行程、费用表和来源说明
phases.note: 每日路线、含备用金的预算和带日期的来源
phases.judgment: 酒店价格只是示例。弘大 L7 的 335 美元一晚来自一条没有入住日期的搜索结果，页面本身也无法确认，所以标为未确认，建议先从 121 美元一晚的那家看起。

phases.title: 最后核对文件、预算算式和页面排版
phases.judgment: 它直说了没做完的部分：排版和预算核对通过，但截图步骤超时，页面的实际外观没能完整检查。

workers: 找出弘大一带的酒店选项，记下公开可见的价格和查看日期
